<?php
/**
 * SessionManager - Handles session persistence with graceful shutdown
 * Uses custom serialization format for session state management
 */

class SessionStore {
    private $storePath;
    private $activeSessions = [];
    private $shutdownRegistered = false;
    private $serializationHandler;

    public function __construct(string $storePath, SerializationHandler $handler) {
        $this->storePath = rtrim($storePath, '/');
        $this->serializationHandler = $handler;
        if (!is_dir($this->storePath)) {
            mkdir($this->storePath, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function loadSession(string $sessionId): ?array {
        $sessionId = $this->sanitizeSessionId($sessionId);
        $filePath = $this->storePath . '/' . $sessionId . '.sess';
        
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $raw = file_get_contents($filePath);
        if ($raw === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $data = $this->serializationHandler->deserialize($raw);
        if (is_array($data)) {
            $this->activeSessions[$sessionId] = $data;
            $this->ensureShutdownHandler();
        }
        return $data;
    }

    public function saveSession(string $sessionId, array $data): bool {
        $sessionId = $this->sanitizeSessionId($sessionId);
        $this->activeSessions[$sessionId] = $data;
        $this->ensureShutdownHandler();
        return true;
    }

    private function ensureShutdownHandler(): void {
        if (!$this->shutdownRegistered) {
            register_shutdown_function([$this, 'gracefulShutdown']);
            $this->shutdownRegistered = true;
        }
    }

    public function gracefulShutdown(): void {
        foreach ($this->activeSessions as $id => $data) {
            $filePath = $this->storePath . '/' . $id . '.sess';
            $serialized = $this->serializationHandler->serialize($data);
            file_put_contents($filePath, $serialized, LOCK_EX);
        }
    }

    private function sanitizeSessionId(string $id): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $id);
    }
}

class SerializationHandler {
    private $allowedClasses;
    private $format;

    const FORMAT_JSON = 'json';
    const FORMAT_NATIVE = 'native';
    const FORMAT_MSGPACK = 'msgpack';

    public function __construct(string $format = self::FORMAT_JSON, array $allowedClasses = []) {
        $this->format = $format;
        $this->allowedClasses = $allowedClasses;
    }

    public function serialize($data): string {
        switch ($this->format) {
            case self::FORMAT_JSON:
                return json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            case self::FORMAT_NATIVE:
                return serialize($data);
            case self::FORMAT_MSGPACK:
                return $this->msgpackEncode($data);
            default:
                throw new \RuntimeException('Unknown format: ' . $this->format);
        }
    }

    public function deserialize(string $raw) {
        $format = $this->detectFormat($raw);
        
        switch ($format) {
            case self::FORMAT_JSON:
                return json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            case self::FORMAT_NATIVE:
                return $this->safeUnserialize($raw);
            case self::FORMAT_MSGPACK:
                return $this->msgpackDecode($raw);
            default:
                throw new \RuntimeException('Cannot detect serialization format');
        }
    }

    private function detectFormat(string $raw): string {
        $firstChar = $raw[0] ?? '';
        
        // JSON starts with { or [
        if ($firstChar === '{' || $firstChar === '[') {
            return self::FORMAT_JSON;
        }
        
        // PHP serialized format starts with type indicators
        if (preg_match('/^[aOsidbN][:;]/', $raw)) {
            return self::FORMAT_NATIVE;
        }
        
        // Assume msgpack for binary data
        return self::FORMAT_MSGPACK;
    }

    private function safeUnserialize(string $raw) {
        // Security: restrict to allowed classes only
        $classes = empty($this->allowedClasses) ? false : $this->allowedClasses;
        return unserialize($raw, ['allowed_classes' => $classes]);
    }

    private function msgpackEncode($data): string {
        if (function_exists('msgpack_pack')) {
            return msgpack_pack($data);
        }
        // Fallback: prefix with binary marker + json
        return "\x92" . json_encode($data);
    }

    private function msgpackDecode(string $raw) {
        if (function_exists('msgpack_unpack')) {
            return msgpack_unpack($raw);
        }
        // Fallback: strip binary marker + json decode
        return json_decode(substr($raw, 1), true);
    }
}

/**
 * MigrationHelper - Handles session format migration during upgrades
 * When upgrading from legacy format, sessions need re-serialization
 */
class MigrationHelper {
    private $store;
    private $legacyHandler;

    public function __construct(SessionStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
        // Legacy systems used native PHP serialization with restricted classes
        $this->legacyHandler = new SerializationHandler(
            SerializationHandler::FORMAT_NATIVE,
            ['stdClass', 'DateTime', 'DateTimeImmutable']
        );
    }

    /**
     * Migrate a legacy session file to new format
     * Called during rolling upgrade process
     */
    public function migrateLegacySession(string $sessionId, string $rawLegacyData): bool {
        // During migration, always use the restricted legacy handler
        // Never dynamically expand the allowed class list based on input
        $data = $this->legacyHandler->deserialize($rawLegacyData);
        
        if (!is_array($data)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Re-save in new format
        return $this->store->saveSession($sessionId, $data);
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$handler = new SerializationHandler(SerializationHandler::FORMAT_JSON);
$store = new SessionStore('/tmp/sessions', $handler);
$migration = new MigrationHelper($store);

// Handle incoming migration request (e.g., from upgrade script)
if (isset($_POST['migrate_session']) && isset($_POST['session_id']) && isset($_POST['legacy_data'])) {
    $sessionId = $_POST['session_id'];
    $legacyData = base64_decode($_POST['legacy_data']);
    $result = $migration->migrateLegacySession($sessionId, $legacyData);
    echo json_encode(['success' => $result]);
}
